drug_landscape: belapectin (GR-MD-02): phase 2b NASH cirrhosis negative on fibrosis (NCT02462967); phase 3 NAVIGATE (NCT04365868) reported 2025
evidence_note_reviewed: Belapectin: earlier cirrhosis trial did not improve fibrosis; NAVIGATE phase 2b studied variceal prevention and did not meet full-analysis primary comparisons.

drug_landscape: pamrevlumab (FG-3019): IPF phase 3; liver fibrosis phase 2 paused
evidence_note_reviewed: Pamrevlumab: phase 2 pulmonary fibrosis study; phase 3 ZEPHYRUS-1 did not meet its primary endpoint. Liver efficacy is unestablished.
